evidence.evidence_text: This study investigates the concept of the ‘right to be forgotten’ within the context of large language models (LLMs).
Our research delineates a comprehensive framework for machine unlearning in pre-trained LLMs, encompassing a critical analysis of seven diverse unlearning methods.
We explore machine unlearning as a pivotal solution, with a focus on pre-trained models–a notably under-researched area.
